📱 Put This App on Your Phone

This puts a little Angel Guide picture on your phone's home screen. After that, you just tap it — like any other app. No password, nothing to buy.

If you have an iPhone

1

Open this page in Safari (the blue compass app).

2

Tap the Share button — the square with an arrow pointing up, at the bottom of the screen.

3

Scroll down a little and tap Add to Home Screen.

4

Tap Add in the top corner. All done! Look for the Angel Guide picture on your home screen.

If you have an Android phone

1

Open this page in Chrome (the round red, yellow, and green app).

2

Tap the three dots in the top corner of the screen.

3

Tap Add to Home screen (on some phones it says Install app).

4

Tap Add. All done! Look for the Angel Guide picture on your home screen.

💡 One helpful tip: if you opened this link inside TikTok, Facebook, or a text message and can't find those buttons, tap the three dots and choose “Open in Browser” first — then follow the steps above.
